mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies with a temperature of 54 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, and please note the air quality index is currently at 51.

The city has two major updates: road construction on Highway M starts Monday, October 5, and will run through October 7 with detours in place, and fall leaf pickup begins on October 5, so remember to rake loose leaves behind the curb.
There is a lot to do in the area today, including the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol, live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired, and a 19-year-old male was eventually detained and jailed.
Culver's of Verona is serving up the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake today and will open today at 10:00 AM.
